mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates a recessionary monetary policy environment, which typically produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches peak growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1200 thousand units, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO rising above 102.0) signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL rising above 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16500 billion dollars) and robust housing starts (HOUST > 1200 thousand units) indicates a healthy demand environment, which typically produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 16500 and HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime characterized by robust payroll growth (PAYEMS rising above 100k per month), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings benefit.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
